tasks.label: C++: g++.exe build active file
args: $sources = @('${file}'); if ('${fileDirname}' -like '*\librerie\*') { $sources = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${fileDirname}' -Filter '*.cpp' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } } else { $library = Join-Path '${fileDirname}' 'library.cpp'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $library) -and ('${file}' -ne $library)) { $sources += $library } }; & 'C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\g++.exe' -fdiagnostics-color=always -g @sources -o '${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
tasks.detail: Build active C++ file; in librerie subfolders it links all .cpp files in the current folder.
